AOK_DEFINITION: Atom of knowledge — an atomized leaf in seedKG (sentence, citation, entity, equation, figure, table) with a Merkle leaf hash, joined to its family by source_seed_id.
SOT_DEFINITION: Seed of truth — a composite verified assertion built out of atoms with >=1 supporting atom Merkle leaf; deterministic assembler in seedgraph/seeds_of_truth/assembler.py (PROMPT-020 STEP1).
